description: Picture of where two STEP parts differ, as PNG images you can look at: an overview and, when there are differences, a close-up. Coloured as in the CAD Compare viewer: faces identical in both grey, differing faces of A red, of B green, and numbered markers whose meaning is in legend (the same differences compare lists). For parts that were only moved or mirrored, B is shown with A's outline on top. Use it when the user wants to see the change, or to check a result visually. Rendered locally without a GPU; files are never uploaded. Requires CAD Compare Pro (see describe → license).

a.description: Absolute path to the first part file (A, usually the older version) (.step or .stp) on this computer. For a file the user attached to the chat, pass the path you have; if it is not on this computer, the file with the same name in the user's folders is used

b.description: Absolute path to the second part file (B) (.step or .stp) on this computer. For a file the user attached to the chat, pass the path you have; if it is not on this computer, the file with the same name in the user's folders is used

output_dir.description: Also save the PNGs into this existing folder (absolute path)

view.description: Viewing direction (default iso: from front-right, above)

name: render_diff

images.description: The PNG images returned as image content, in this order

legend.description: Numbered purple markers in the images → the difference at that spot
